hypothesis: A minimal venue-neutral timestamp/provenance contract can fail closed on bad market data without importing predecessor runtime code or changing the active experiment.
observed_result: The pure contract distinguishes VALID, DEGRADED, STALE, and UNAVAILABLE; only VALID permits downstream action. Missing provenance, impossible timestamp order, excess event age, and excess transport age fail closed.
reversal_conditions: A future venue requires stronger provenance fields.
Tests reveal an invalid timestamp chain can pass.
A consumer attempts to treat DEGRADED, STALE, or UNAVAILABLE as actionable.
